a hidden truncation approach for the classical Pareto (II), which we refer to as the hidden truncated (both-sided) bivariate Pareto model, is a useful tool to model data that are likely to have been truncated with regard to some unobserving covariable.
the hidden truncation formulation is a very flexible model for the analysis of income and wealth data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hidden truncation model is not only more flexible, but also provides a more accurate description of real world data.
the classical Pareto model is a special case of the proposed hidden truncated model.
